verdict.rationale: Belvo's API reference lives at a path named for an OpenAPI spec (/apis/belvoopenapispec), which covers multiple API families. It also publishes Postman collections for its Aggregation and Payments workspaces, a machine-readable equivalent that a community member praised. However, a probe of the standard OpenAPI paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known) returned 404, and no evidence shows a direct download link for the raw spec. missing for 10: an explicit downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger file URL, a discoverable spec at a standard path, hands-on confirmation of downloading the spec.
